findings.text: The done_when requires that every test file importing a changed production module, plus the listed gate files, add no failure against a base arm, but the arms cover only four of the eight test files that import the changed modules: tests/test_crew.py, tests/test_a_promoted_code_review_is_stored.py, tests/test_a_lane_change_keeps_its_waivers.py and tests/test_crew_lane_change.py all import reckon/crew_run_commands.py and ran in neither arm.

The round-trip check that keeps _day_from_name's accepted names identical to _day_file_name is guarded by no test: removing the parsed.date().isoformat() != stamp clause widens the domain to time-bearing stamps and no suite test would redden, because day_name_domain.log is a one-off script rather than an assertion.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit; aec25ad98 replaces date.fromisoformat with parse_utc plus a round-trip test in station_store, renames the sweep's help line, and moves the live/resolved expectation while adding a disagreement refusal assertion; ce6924746 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py::test_every_crew_verb_help_names_its_state_or_condition, tests/test_crew_path_prints_the_resolved_home.py::test_a_selector_a_kind_does_not_take_is_refused and tests/test_structural_invariants.py::test_only_the_shared_parser_calls_fromisoformat; gate.log records all three passing at ce6924746.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to make the three census ids of the plan's section pass by asserting each intended contract or reporting the unintended change; all three pass at ce6924746 and each id's driving commit is named in the evidence fragment, including the correction that the live case fails as --project beside --run rather than a --run selector.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records commits aec25ad98 and ce6924746 and states the gate result, the two arms and the three negative controls, though its artifacts line omits any ruff receipt.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares seven write paths; the diff touches only tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py, tests/test_crew_path_prints_the_resolved_home.py, reckon/crew/station_store.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/invariant-ids-in-claimed-modules-name-one-owner.html, all inside them.

justifications.durability: Each added assertion reddens on its own reinstated regression as negative_control.log shows, but the round-trip guard at reckon/crew/station_store.py:233 has no test behind it.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records 17 passed EXIT=0 at ce6924746 and arm-base.log 3 failed/58 passed EXIT=1 against arm-head.log 61 passed EXIT=0, but the arms cover only four of the eight test files that import the changed modules.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station_store.py:220 and reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1583 follow the surrounding docstring style and introduce no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All three census ids pass at ce6924746 (gate.log 17 passed), and the evidence fragment names the commit read for each id: 81b4ea57e, 8bac47b79 and 8dd3a03d0.
justifications.reuse: No definition is added; reckon/crew/station_store.py:233 now calls the existing owner reckon/_timestamps.py:parse_utc rather than forking a second parser, which is the capability the structural invariant tracks.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the e047134db..ce6924746 diff is inside the declared write paths; tests/test_structural_invariants.py was left untouched and no figure was written.
